scripts.dev: node --run dev:db && (npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web & wait)
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: node tools/third-party.ts all --audit-optional && npm run build -w web
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w web && npm test -w e2e
scripts.screenshots: npm run build -w web && playwright test -c tools/screenshots
